findings.title: Saved-byte scenario incorrectly enters reorg completion
findings.detail: preferenceReorg includes preference-saved. Saved branch bypasses the else-if reorg branch that assigns pausePreferenceBoundary and completePreferenceReorg. Normal tail invokes the undefined pause function at1183 after the paid saved operation, and post-miner tail also selects undefined completion at1192. Saved-specific job branch1069 is unreachable.
findings.requiredRepair: Exclude preference-saved from reorg-only flag while retaining generic preferences membership. Add a meaningful scenario-dispatch regression covering normal saved completion versus initialization/marker reorg continuations, not only source presence assertions.
